description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Blitzcrank''' shifts into overdrive, gaining [[File:Attack speed icon.png|15px|link=Attack speed]] '''bonus''' attack speed for 5 seconds and [[File:Movement speed icon.png|15px|link=Movement speed]] '''bonus''' movement speed that decays to 10% over the first 2.9 seconds.
description.text: Active: Blitzcrank shifts into overdrive, gaining  bonus attack speed for 5 seconds and  bonus movement speed that decays to 10% over the first 2.9 seconds.

description2.raw: When ''Overdrive'' ends, '''Blitzcrank''' is [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slowed]] by 30% for 1.5 seconds.
description2.text: When Overdrive ends, Blitzcrank is slowed by 30% for 1.5 seconds.

notes.text:
The movement speed boost's decay is linear. On the first stat update after the buff is gained, the boost does not decay.
